props.name: count
props.description: Number of seeds, and so of cells. The clipping is O(n²), so a few dozen is the sweet spot.

props.name: speed
props.description: Drift speed in pixels per frame at 60fps.

props.name: attraction
props.description: How strongly seeds lean towards the pointer, 0 to turn it off.

props.name: reach
props.description: Radius around the pointer, in pixels, inside which seeds are pulled.

props.name: color
props.description: Colour the cells are tinted from — a token such as `var(--color-accent)`, or any CSS colour.

props.name: showSeeds
props.description: Draw a dot at each seed.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seed for the layout, so the same field comes back on every visit.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged last, so it wins. Give the component a size here.
